Construct: Version 2 options, source order, effective top and parameter settings
Positive evidence: Equivalent v1/v2 manifests yield byte-identical lowered models; a v1 manifest reopens a v2 proof
Negative evidence: Seven invalid manifests and a duplicate CLI parameter override reject
Boundary evidence: CLI override wins over manifest value; wrong effective value rejects certificate
Source and model evidence: Input-set digest and archived manifest schema are compared
Limitations: Only configured SystemVerilog source kinds and the published manifest options

Construct: Project relocation with included macro, bound monitor and standalone property
Positive evidence: Two project roots yield identical T-IR, property inventory and seven certificate files
Negative evidence: Changing the active header changes identity and invalidates the earlier certificate
Boundary evidence: Both roots contain spaces and certificates verify from the other root
Source and model evidence: Bound and standalone source mapping checked; standalone DRAT accepts three obligations; modified header yields a source-replayed counterexample
Limitations: This composition test exercises identical bytes across two Windows paths

Construct: Ordered object macros and conditional compilation
Positive evidence: Active branch and nested expansion produce the expected property results
Negative evidence: Undefined macro, recursive expansion, unterminated conditional and unsupported directive reject
Boundary evidence: Ordered compilation units and conditional macro state
Source and model evidence: Invalid directive and invalid invocations carry file and line; resolved project is replayed from archive
Limitations: Conditional selection follows the supported directives; unsupported compiler directives reject

Construct: Function macro formal parameters and default arguments
Positive evidence: Function expansion, nested arguments, defaults and an empty permitted argument configuration pass
Negative evidence: Duplicate formal, missing and excess arguments, malformed delimiter and unterminated argument list reject
Boundary evidence: Nested argument lists and explicit override of default
Source and model evidence: Malformed calls report the invocation location; checked proof and archived replay exercise substitutions
Limitations: Supported token expansion and default forms only

Positive evidence: Continuation across formal parameters and replacement tokens, including an inactive branch, preserves property result
Negative evidence: Trailing whitespace after the continuation backslash rejects
Boundary evidence: Both LF and CRLF; deliberately false expected bits return a witness for each
Source and model evidence: Malformed continuation reports the directive line and a checked PDR certificate revalidates

Positive evidence: Pasted port names, nested macro names and a sized based literal match source intent
Negative evidence: Paste that yields multiple tokens or omits either operand rejects
Boundary evidence: Object and function macro paste; paste before further expansion
Source and model evidence: Invalid paste points to invocation; archived replay survives live header change
Limitations: Paste must form one accepted token

Construct: Quoted nested include and ordered search paths
Positive evidence: Guarded nested include selects the expected header; bundle reopens with archived content
Negative evidence: Traversal, missing include, unguarded cycle and reordered archived header roster reject
Boundary evidence: Source-local search precedes manifest include directories; guarded recursion terminates
Source and model evidence: Header hashes, archived replay and header-source debug provenance checked
Limitations: Active relative quoted includes within the supported project root

Positive evidence: Nested macro expansion and a default argument resolve a quoted header
Boundary evidence: Expanded path uses normal search precedence and archived dependency order
Source and model evidence: Checked proof and snapshot replay reproduce expanded header dependency
Limitations: Complete expansion must produce a single permitted quoted path

Construct: Macro quotation for a quoted include path
Positive evidence: Object and function quotation produce expected includes with default arguments
Negative evidence: Malformed or invalid quoted operands reject
Boundary evidence: Nested expansion and embedded literal spacing
Source and model evidence: Checked DRAT and archived replay reproduce the selected header
Limitations: Single-line quotation; general string-valued RTL remains outside the profile

Construct: Version 2 source units with no active declarations
Positive evidence: Definitions-only and include-only units supply macros to a later design
Negative evidence: No top, version 1 empty input, a raw empty parse and an unclosed directive reject
Boundary evidence: Three source units retain their manifest order, including a comment-only unit
Source and model evidence: Two replayed failures and two checked induction proofs reopen from source with the ordered source roster and active header
Limitations: Version 2 manifest only. The selected top must elaborate

Positive evidence: Type-wide monitor and exact generated target work with named/positional connections
Negative evidence: Seven invalid or unsupported binds reject
Boundary evidence: Parameter override, static generated index, exact-width port association, scoped assumptions
Source and model evidence: Bind diagnostics locate directive; checked DRAT and replay from archived bind sources
Limitations: Input-only monitor modules and supported target forms; bind target instance lists excluded

Construct: Standalone and hierarchically referenced concurrent properties
Positive evidence: Named and inline properties bind clocks and resolve nested generated signals
Negative evidence: Unresolved path, wrong root, dynamic index and invalid clock reject
Boundary evidence: Top-relative and root-qualified paths with guarded history and local assumptions
Source and model evidence: Source-located diagnostics and archived property source regenerate proof/witness model
Limitations: One positive-edge clock and literal nonnegative generated indices

Construct: Elaborated inventory and source/derived dependency identity
Positive evidence: Properties command and saved result agree on selected source operands and model dependencies
Negative evidence: Both rehashed RTL and derived inventory mismatches are rejected on reopen
Boundary evidence: Hierarchy and history-generated signals appear in their declared output fields
Source and model evidence: File, line, clock, and ordered signal inventories checked against fixtures
Limitations: Reports elaborated supported properties, including synthesized history dependencies

Construct: Sized literals in delays and repetition bounds
Positive evidence: BMC and PDR cover at independently expected samples; induction validates both obligations
Negative evidence: Negative signed count, invalid range and zero repetition cases reject
Boundary evidence: Small width truncation to zero delay; exact/range endpoints evaluated with declared type
Source and model evidence: Invalid constants report source; proofs and witnesses revalidate
Limitations: Finite timing and positive repetition bounds

Construct: Folded constant expressions in delay/repetition bounds
Positive evidence: Twenty expected BMC/PDR cover frames and ten proof checks for default and overridden parameters
Negative evidence: Two runtime references, a negative count, zero repetition and reversed range reject
Boundary evidence: Default and explicit top parameter overrides alter finite offsets as expected
Source and model evidence: Source-backed witness and proof revalidation; invalid bounds checked before publication
Limitations: Supported compile-time integral expression grammar and finite horizon limits

Positive evidence: Four safety/cover certificates independently recheck and temporal witnesses replay
Negative evidence: Contradictory complete prefix and excessive horizon rejected without proof publication
Boundary evidence: Initial incomplete guarded windows retained; exact witness depth checked
Source and model evidence: Ordered resolved assumption identities, source verification and standalone clause-scan proof checks
Limitations: Finite assumption horizon within engine profile

Construct: Unsupported temporal operators and event controls
Positive evidence: Supported finite delay and unary-plus packed index remain accepted
Negative evidence: 120 independent command decisions classify 18 exclusions and two malformed forms across inline/standalone scopes and three engines
Boundary evidence: Same exclusions exercised under BMC, induction and PDR; diagnostic category distinguishes grammar errors
Source and model evidence: Exact structured file/line/column checked and artifact publication forbidden on these inputs
Limitations: Evidence covers the tested exclusions and malformed controls

Construct: Nonoverlapped implication with a positive antecedent repetition range and a consequent delay range
Positive evidence: Independent truth table matches 80 assertion and cover outcomes over all 16 source patterns
Negative evidence: Replays distinguish one failed antecedent obligation from a cover hit on a different match
Boundary evidence: Short and long matches use opposite delay endpoints; absent, single and simultaneous matches are exercised
Source and model evidence: 25 source-backed witnesses reopen; 88 standalone DRAT obligations validate
Limitations: Saturation fixture with one starting phase; BMC and PDR exercise assertion and cover, and k-induction exercises assertion

Construct: Constant bit and part selects of explicitly packed parameters and localparams
Positive evidence: Selections work in localparam initializers, packed widths, child overrides, generate branches, RTL assignments and SVA
Negative evidence: Out-of-range, reversed, dynamic and chained selections reject at their source; invalid initializer selection also rejects
Boundary evidence: Ascending signed declaration crosses index zero; override shifts its origin; unsigned part-select and 64-bit full-width boundary checked
Source and model evidence: Two configurations produce six checked engine outcomes, two injected failures and two sample-three covers; ten standalone DRAT obligations validate
Limitations: One declared packed dimension and fixed direction-matched endpoints; inferred, dynamic, indexed and chained selects are outside this case
